author: AceReviews7165
quote: As a lifelong gamer, I went into this game positive, expecting another amazing GTA experience. What I played was a slap in the face. Rockstar should be ashamed and have lost a lifelong fan. The game is flat-out boring. The characters are dull. The graphics are superb, but it doesn’t hold any weight to how awful the actual content of the game is. There is barely any crime. No excitement. No chaos. No laughs. I’m not sure how anyone can enjoy this, and my favorite game genre is usually slow paced rpgs. This game is a major disappointment and Rockstar needs to internally evaluate their decisions.
